expectations.text: The agent runs the deterministic readiness script before reporting a score
expectations.evidence: The output includes the exact check_readiness.py command.

expectations.text: The score and rating match the script output
expectations.evidence: Reports 4/10, 40%, developing, matching the raw JSON.

expectations.text: Recommendations are grounded in missing checks
expectations.evidence: Prioritizes missing agent context and agent instructions and states presence is not quality.

expectations.text: Present and missing readiness dimensions are distinguished accurately
expectations.evidence: The report separates present and missing dimensions and warns hypothetical facts need actual inspection.

expectations.text: Repeatable workflows are not credited without a recognized artifact
expectations.evidence: The report recommends focused SKILL.md or prompt artifacts for the hand-repeated workflows while distinguishing existing workflow points.

expectations.text: The first recommendation follows the deterministic priority order
expectations.evidence: AGENTS.md is recommended first as priority 1.

expectations.text: The initial audit happens before artifact creation
expectations.evidence: The output records a baseline audit before creating AGENTS.md.

expectations.text: Only one focused artifact is added
expectations.evidence: The output lists only AGENTS.md in the temporary copy.

expectations.text: The final score comes from a rerun of the deterministic script
expectations.evidence: The final audit reports 7/10 after rerunning check_readiness.py.
